dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent O-shaped structures in the superior-midsection; high-intensity white perimeters transition sharply to low-intensity black cores. One large central annulus is flanked by two smaller rings to the left and two slightly larger, elongated rings to the right.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density; solid high-intensity pixel clusters without internal gradients are concentrated in the anterior-most region and sporadically along the inferior-lateral boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest superior annuli define an obtuse triangle with the longest side oriented parallel to the dorsal ridge; four smaller blobs in the anterior-midsection form a trapezoidal pattern.
